metadata.title: Clicked like I was swatting a ghost and somehow dragged 1 poor soul to rage quit
metadata.description:
Spam-clicking like my mouse was possessed.
Enemy probably wondering if I’m cheating or just lucky.
Did NOT deserve that chaos but hey, I’ll take the freebie.
If your aim’s a beautiful accident, this one’s for you.

Tap if you’ve ever gotten a kill by pure accident!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
